name: godmode
description: One plugin for Claude Code and Codex, built from a single source: nine coding workflow skills and ten no-auth MCP servers.

interface.shortDescription: Nine coding workflows and ten no-auth MCP servers.
interface.longDescription: Godmode adds nine coding workflow skills (revelation, gospel, prophecy, genesis, summon, judgment, sanctify, exorcise, covenant) and ten MCP servers that need no API key: documentation (Context7, Microsoft Learn, AWS Knowledge, Cloudflare Docs, Keeper Docs), code intelligence (DeepWiki, grep.app), browser automation (Playwright, Chrome DevTools) and cloud (Azure). In Claude Code it also adds five subagents (oracle, demiurge, inquisitor, arbiter, seer) and three hooks. Claude Code and Codex load the same files, built from one source.
defaultPrompt: Use godmode:revelation to explain how this codebase fits together
Use godmode:judgment to review my uncommitted changes
Use godmode:exorcise to find why the failing test in this file fails
